headlines.title_en: Wall Street Breakfast | July 27, 2026
headlines.summary_en: International crude oil opened lower on Monday, with Brent crude falling over 7% to below $90, while Nasdaq futures rose over 1%. US and Iran paused mutual attacks: Iran's military said Sunday that the US halted attacks for two consecutive nights, and Iran suspended tit-for-tat strikes. Red Sea tensions escalated: Yemen's Houthi group attacked Saudi oil facilities in the Red Sea port twice on Saturday, with Saudi Arabia retaliating with airstrikes. Former CSRC Vice Chairman Fang Xinghai is under investigation. Wang Yi met with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi, stating China will continue to support Pakistan and other parties' mediation efforts to resume dialogue and properly handle the Hormuz Strait issue. China's Ministry of Commerce added 14 EU entities to export control list. Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration: Resident individuals' assets placed in offshore trusts and trust income must pay individual income tax. China's top judicial authorities revised judicial interpretations to intensify punishment for insider trading and leaking insider information.

headlines.summary: 上半年，规模以上原材料制造业利润同比增长71.7%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.8个百分点。从行业看，在铜、铝等有色金属产品需求向好等因素推动下，有色行业利润增长99.4%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长4.7个百分点；在石油产业链条相关产品价格上涨推动下，石油加工行业同比扭亏为盈，化工行业利润增长67.8%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Raw materials manufacturing profits grew rapidly in H1.
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of the year, profits of raw material manufacturing firms above designated size rose 71.7% year-on-year, contributing 8.8 percentage points to overall industrial profit growth. Driven by strong demand for copper and aluminum, nonferrous metal industry profits rose 99.4%, contributing 4.7 percentage points. Fueled by rising oil product prices, petroleum processing turned from loss to profit, and chemical industry profits increased 67.8%.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%
headlines.summary: 电子相关行业利润高速增长。上半年，人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.5个百分点，是规模以上工业企业利润较快增长的重要支撑。其中，服务器、高性能工作站相关领域中，计算机整机制造、计算机外围设备制造行业利润分别增长689.3%、305.8%；电子器件制造领域中，集成电路制造、半导体分立器件制造行业利润增长2579.5%、31.2%；电子元件及电子专用材料制造领域中，电子专用材料制造、电子电路制造行业利润增长209.7%、26.9%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: AI integration across sectors boosted data demand, driving electronics industry profit up 96.9% YoY in H1.
headlines.summary_en: Electronics-related industry profits grew rapidly. In the first half, AI integration across sectors boosted computing demand, lifting electronics industry profits 96.9% year-on-year, contributing 8.5 percentage points to overall industrial profit growth. Among sub-sectors: computer manufacturing and peripheral equipment profits rose 689.3% and 305.8%; integrated circuit and semiconductor device manufacturing profits surged 2579.5% and 31.2%; electronic materials and circuit manufacturing profits increased 209.7% and 26.9%.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Securities News: August market may see rotational recovery, with focus accelerating toward earnings verification
headlines.summary_en: Last week, A-shares saw a volatile recovery with all major indices ending the week higher. Structural divergence was prominent, with signals of funds rotating from high to low and style diversification. Broker strategy reports suggest recent regulators and state-owned enterprises signaling buybacks and increases, plus easing liquidity pressure, have laid a foundation for a bottom. Looking ahead, the market focus is shifting to half-year earnings verification, advising balanced positioning and seeking structural opportunities in tech growth divergence.

headlines.title: 中国即将发行或正在发行的国债和政策性金融债
headlines.summary: 上半年，规模以上原材料制造业利润同比增长71.7%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.8个百分点。从行业看，在铜、铝等有色金属产品需求向好等因素推动下，有色行业利润增长99.4%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长4.7个百分点；在石油产业链条相关产品价格上涨推动下，石油加工行业同比扭亏为盈，化工行业利润增长67.8%。
